education.summary: • Bachelor of Engineering Degree in Electrical Electronics Engineering

• Cloud Foundations - Learnt the fundamentals of cloud computing while being introduced to compute power, security, storage, networking, messaging, and management services in the cloud. 
	 • Full Stack Apps on AWS ‑ Designed and deployed scalable, extendable, and maintainable full stack applications using modern cloud architecture. 
	• Monolith to Microservices at Scale ‑ Learnt best practices on how to develop and deploy microservices, with a focus on different microservice architecture patterns, independent scaling, resiliency, securing microservices, and best practices for monitoring and logging. 
	• Develop and Deploy Serverless App ‑ Learnt both the theory of using serverless technologies with the practice of developing a complex server‑less application and focuses on learning by doing. I learnt advanced serverless features such as implementing WebSockets and stream processing.

• Backend Development with Node.js - Learnt how to work with Node.js and the core modules available, writing TypeScript for developer error reduction, testing with Jasmine to introduce unit testing in a Test Driven Development environment, and working with Express as a framework for building APIs. 
	 • Creating an API with PostgreSQL and Express ‑ This course covers the primary skills required for API development. I built a RESTful JSON API with Node and Postgres. Along the way, I learnt essential topics like databases and querying, API architecture, database migrations, REST, CRUD, creating a testing environment, password hashing and route authorization via JWTs. By completing the exercises and course content, I gained the knowledge to create a secure, well organized API from scratch and learnt skills JavaScript developers use every day. 
	• Deployment Process (CI/CD, EBk, S3, Circle‑CI) ‑ Learnt how to create a production environment and automate the deployment of code to it. Built automated pipelines and wrote scripts to gain insights into the world of automated deployments.

• This was a project‑based learning journey building declarative user interfaces, making state more predictable, and boosting app efficiency and robustness. I also had the opportunity to develop mobile apps for iOS and Android devices using React-native.

	• React Fundamentals
	• React and Redux
	• React Native

work.summary:
• ZICMA Carbon Credit Marketplace Platform: Architected and built production-grade backend system from scratch processing $1M+ in transactions. Designed NestJS monorepo with 3 microservices (Portal API, Admin API, Worker Service) using TypeScript, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, and Redis. System handles complex financial transactions, blockchain settlements, and automated credit processing with 99.9% uptime. 
• Scalable Architecture & Performance Optimization: Implemented Redis caching layer reducing database load by 60%+, optimized PostgreSQL queries with connection pooling for high-throughput scenarios, and designed horizontal scaling with stateless containerized services. Built comprehensive metrics collection with Prometheus tracking HTTP requests, GraphQL operations, and database performance. 
• DevOps & Infrastructure Automation: Established complete CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions for automated testing, building, and deployment across test, demo, and production environments. Configured AWS ECS with sidecar containers (Prometheus, PostgreSQL exporter, CloudWatch exporter) for full observability. Set up Grafana dashboards and alerting rules for proactive issue detection. 
• Blockchain Integration & Security: Integrated Fireblocks for secure digital asset custody, built smart contract interaction layer with proper error handling and retry logic. Implemented JWT authentication with RBAC, MFA, OAuth (Google, Microsoft), and KYC/AML compliance workflows. Designed idempotent transaction handling with error recovery and rollback mechanisms. 
• Third-Party Integrations & Compliance: Integrated payment gateways (Stripe, Paynow), KYC providers, built dedicated IPFS server for decentralized storage, and implemented webhook processing with hash validation. System helped secure $2.5M government contract through demonstrated reliability and compliance.

• Platform Architecture & Development: Built entire backend infrastructure for renewable energy investment platform using NestJS, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, and AWS. Architected scalable system handling complex financial transactions and project management workflows. Platform helped secure $1M in investor funding through technical excellence and reliability. 
• AWS Infrastructure Optimization: Migrated and optimized all AWS services (EC2, RDS, S3, IAM) from legacy account to new infrastructure, reducing AWS costs by 25% while improving performance and security posture. Implemented best practices for resource management and cost optimization. 
• Web3 Integration & Blockchain Services: Collaborated with Web3 team to integrate blockchain services using web3.js, ethers.js, and SIWE (Sign-In with Ethereum). Built secure wallet management, smart contract interactions, and transaction monitoring systems for decentralized finance features. 
• CI/CD Pipeline & Automation: Developed automated CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions and AWS EC2, eliminating manual deployments and reducing errors. Implemented automated testing, code quality checks, and deployment workflows across multiple environments. 
• Security & Authentication: Enhanced application security with OAuth and JWT authentication, implementing role-based access control and multi-factor authentication. Improved data integrity and user trust through comprehensive security measures.

• System Architecture & Performance: Engineered highly efficient and scalable backend architecture using NestJS, Node.js, and Express, resulting in 40% increase in system performance. Implemented advanced database management strategies utilizing PostgreSQL and Sequelize, leading to 60% reduction in query response times. 
• DevOps & Deployment Automation: Automated deployment and integration workflows using CircleCI and AWS Elastic Beanstalk, reducing manual errors by 70%. Streamlined data storage and retrieval processes by integrating AWS S3, resulting in 50% increase in data access speed.

• CI/CD Pipeline Implementation: Deployed powerful CI/CD pipeline using CircleCI, resulting in 50% reduction in deployment errors, 20% increase in productivity, and significant boost in customer satisfaction through improved development cycle transparency. 
• Enterprise Integration Architecture: Designed and deployed integrative endpoints connecting procurement system with multiple accounting platforms including Microsoft Dynamics 365, Odoo ERP, Amazon Business, Zero Accounting, and Oracle NetSuite. Improved data flow and operational efficiency across enterprise systems. 
• API Architecture & Cloud Integration: Transformed API architecture by implementing robust and scalable RESTful API using NestJS/Node.js, integrating with AWS S3 for file storage. Enhanced customer experience through seamless API integration and improved performance.

• Performance Optimization & SEO: Revamped company website implementing advanced SEO strategies, achieving Page Speed performance score of 87%. Executed extensive end-to-end testing using Cypress, guaranteeing 100% code compliance with product requirements. 
• Agile Development & User Engagement: Successfully delivered high-quality applications within Agile-driven timelines, resulting in 20% increase in user engagement. Implemented UI/UX designs for data visualization dashboards with focus on user experience and accessibility.

• Agile Development & Quality Assurance: Developed robust and scalable applications in Agile environment, ensuring project timelines were met and delivering high-quality products with significant user impact. Optimized website performance utilizing SEO strategies, achieving Page Speed score of 87. 
• Testing & Deployment: Implemented comprehensive end-to-end testing using Cypress Library to guarantee code met product requirements and ensured seamless deployment to production. Maintained high code quality standards throughout development lifecycle.

• Process Improvement & Best Practices: Improved development processes and technologies by recommending and implementing best practices, resulting in 20% reduction in development time and 15% increase in overall productivity. 
• Scalable Backend Services: Designed and implemented scalable backend services, resulting in 50% increase in system performance and 30% reduction in server response time. Collaborated effectively with front-end developers to integrate new features, resulting in seamless user experience and 25% reduction in bug reports.

Readable.description:
• Readable is a Fullstack content and comment web application similar to reddit built with Next.js for the frontend and NodeJs for the backend, In the app Users will be able to post content to predefined categories, comment on their posts and other users posts, and vote on posts and comments. would-you-rather.name: Would You Rather
would-you-rather.description: Would you rather is a web app that let's a user play the game Would you Rather?. Users need to be logged in to see the application content and the game goes like this: A user is asked a question in the form: 'Would You Rather? [option A] or [option B]' The app will let users answer questions, see already answered questions, create a new question and see the top 3 users on a ranking leaderboard.

my-reads.name: My Reads
my-reads.description: MyReads is a bookshelf app that allows us to select and categorize books that we have read, currently reading, or want to read and also to view details of a particular book on a different page. The project emphasizes using React Fundamentals to build the application and provides an API server and client library to persist information as we interact with the application.
